_comment: Scan self-checks for the NAILS forensic oracle. The positive controls are baseline records the pipeline plants on the 'after' image and that the scan must detect: if one is missing the scan is blind and the run fails (never 'clean'), because a scan that cannot see a record it should cannot be trusted to report no residue. The canary is a fixed marker planted on every image; finding it proves the scan read the image's contents at all. 'tool' pins the channel that must surface it, or any channel when null; 'path' and 'field' locate it (an absolute image path, or a bulk_extractor feature type + value). Keep these in step with what the pipeline actually plants.

positive_controls.name: wtmpdb-boot
positive_controls.note: Synthetic slice: any channel that recovers the file counts. Real-image slice should pin tool to plaso (or a SQL-reader channel) and field to the boot row, so detection proves the record was parsed, not merely recovered.
